question_mn: Ам.долларын хүсэлтүүдийн хамгийн их хүссэн хугацаа хэдэн сар вэ?
question_latin: Am.dollariin hvseltvvdiin hamgiin ih hvssen hugatsaa heden sar we?
question_en: What is the longest requested term, in months, among USD applications?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(requested_term_months) AS max_term_months FROM t2s.loan_applications WHERE currency_code = 'USD'

question_mn: 2025 онд зээлийн хүсэлт гаргасан давхардаагүй харилцагч хэд вэ?
question_latin: 2025 ond zeeliin khuselt gargasan davkhardaagui khariltsagch hed ve?
question_en: How many distinct customers submitted a loan application in 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM t2s.loan_applications WHERE submitted_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'

question_mn: Дефолтын магадлал нь 10 хувиас өндөр гарсан скоринг хэд байна?
question_latin: Defoltiin magadlal ni 10 huwias undur garsan skoring hed baina?
question_en: How many credit scores have an estimated probability of default above 10%?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM t2s.credit_scores WHERE pd_estimate > 0.10

question_mn: ЖДҮ-ийн скорингийн моделиор хэдэн хүсэлт үнэлэгдсэн бэ?
question_latin: JDU-iin skoringiin modeliar kheden khuselt unelegdsen be?
question_en: How many applications were scored with the SME application scoring model?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM t2s.credit_scores WHERE model_code = 'APP_SCORE_SME'

question_mn: Энэ сард ирсэн төгрөгийн хүсэлтүүдээс хамгийн их хүссэн дүн хэд байв?
question_latin: Ene sard irsen tugrugiin hvseltvvdees hamgiin ih hvssen dvn hed baiw?
question_en: What was the largest requested amount among MNT applications received this month?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(requested_amount) FROM t2s.loan_applications WHERE currency_code = 'MNT' AND submitted_date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-30'

question_mn: LA-2025-000894 дугаартай хүсэлтийн төлөв, хүссэн дүн, батлагдсан дүнг харуул
question_latin: LA-2025-000894 dugaartai khuseltiin tolov, khussen dun, batlagdsan dung kharuul
question_en: Show the status, requested amount and approved amount of application LA-2025-000894.
gold_sql: SELECT status_name, requested_amount, approved_amount FROM t2s.loan_applications WHERE application_no = 'LA-2025-000894'

question_mn: Гурав ба түүнээс олон удаа зээлийн хүсэлт гаргасан харилцагч хэд байна?
question_latin: Guraw ba tvvnees olon udaa zeeliin hvselt gargasan hariltsagch hed baina?
question_en: How many customers have submitted three or more loan applications?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM t2s.loan_applications GROUP BY customer_id HAVING count(*) >= 3) t

question_mn: Батлагдсан хүсэлтүүдийн хэдэн хувь нь гэрээ байгуулж зээл болсон бэ?
question_latin: Batlagdsan khuseltuudiin kheden khuvi ni geree baiguulj zeel bolson be?
question_en: What percentage of approved applications went on to sign a contract and become loans?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE status_code = 'CONTRACTED') / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE status_code IN ('APPROVED','CONTRACTED','EXPIRED')), 0), 2) AS conversion_pct FROM t2s.loan_applications

question_mn: 2026 оны 1-р улиралд Зээлийн хороогоор батлагдсан төгрөгийн хүсэлтийн тоо болон нийт батлагдсан дүнг гарга
question_latin: 2026 onii 1-r ulirald Zeeliin horoogoor batlagdsan tugrugiin hvseltiin too bolon niit batlagdsan dvng garga
question_en: Show the number of MNT applications approved by the Credit Committee in Q1 2026 and their total approved amount.
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) AS applications, SUM(approved_amount) AS total_approved FROM t2s.loan_applications WHERE decision_level = 'CREDIT_COMMITTEE' AND status_code IN ('APPROVED','CONTRACTED','EXPIRED') AND currency_code = 'MNT' AND decided_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-03-31'

question_mn: Харилцагчийн сегмент бүрээр хүсэлтийн дундаж скорингийн оноог гарга
question_latin: Khariltsagchiin segment bureer khuseltiin dundaj skoringiin onoog garga
question_en: Show the average application credit score for each customer segment.
question_mixed: Customer segment бүрээр хүсэлтийн average credit score-ийг гарга
gold_sql: SELECT c.segment_name, ROUND(AVG(a.credit_score), 2) AS avg_score FROM t2s.loan_applications a JOIN t2s.customers c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment_name

question_mn: Бүтээгдэхүүний төрөл тус бүрээр хүсэлтүүдийн DTI-ийн медиан утгыг гарга
question_latin: Bvteegdehvvnii turul tus bvreer hvseltvvdiin DTI-iin median utgiig garga
question_en: Show the median DTI of applications for each product type.
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_type_name, ROUND(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY a.dti_ratio)::numeric, 2) AS median_dti FROM t2s.loan_applications a JOIN t2s.products p ON p.product_id = a.product_id GROUP BY p.product_type_name

question_mn: Жил бүр суваг тус бүрээс хэдэн хүсэлт ирснийг гарга
question_latin: Jil bur suvag tus burees kheden khuselt irsniig garga
question_en: Show how many applications came from each channel in each year.
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM submitted_date)::int AS year, channel, count(*) AS applications FROM t2s.loan_applications GROUP BY 1, 2

question_mn: Долоо хоногийн өдөр бүрээр зээлийн хүсэлтийн тоог гарга (1 = даваа)
question_latin: Doloo honogiin udur bvreer zeeliin hvseltiin toog garga (1 = dawaa)
question_en: Show the number of loan applications by day of the week (1 = Monday).
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM submitted_date)::int AS weekday, count(*) AS applications FROM t2s.loan_applications GROUP BY 1

question_mn: Ажлаас гарсан зээлийн мэргэжилтнүүд тус бүр нийт хэдэн хүсэлт хариуцаж байсныг гарга
question_latin: Ajlaas garsan zeeliin mergejiltnuud tus bur niit kheden khuselt khariutsaj baisniig garga
question_en: For each loan officer who has left the company, show how many applications they handled in total.
gold_sql: SELECT e.full_name, count(*) AS applications FROM t2s.loan_applications a JOIN t2s.employees e ON e.employee_id = a.loan_officer_id WHERE e.employment_status = 'TERMINATED' GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.full_name

question_mn: Хүсэлт илгээснээс зээл олгох хүртэл дунджаар хэдэн хоног болдгийг бүтээгдэхүүн бүрээр гарга
question_latin: Hvselt ilgeesnees zeel olgoh hvrtel dundjaar heden honog boldgiig bvteegdehvvn bvreer garga
question_en: For each product, show the average number of days from application submission to loan disbursement.
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name, ROUND(AVG(l.disbursement_date - a.submitted_date), 2) AS avg_days FROM t2s.loan_applications a JOIN t2s.loans l ON l.application_id = a.application_id JOIN t2s.products p ON p.product_id = a.product_id WHERE l.disbursement_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.product_name

question_mn: Батлагдсан төгрөгийн хүсэлтүүдийн хувьд нийт хүссэн дүнгийн хэдэн хувийг баталсан бэ? Шийдвэрийн түвшин бүрээр гарга
question_latin: Batlagdsan tugrugiin hvseltvvdiin huwid niit hvssen dvngiin heden huwiig batalsan be? Shiidweriin tvwshin bvreer garga
question_en: For approved MNT applications, what percentage of the total requested amount was approved? Show it by decision level.
gold_sql: SELECT decision_level, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(approved_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(requested_amount), 0), 2) AS approved_share_pct FROM t2s.loan_applications WHERE currency_code = 'MNT' AND status_code IN ('APPROVED','CONTRACTED','EXPIRED') GROUP BY decision_level

question_mn: 2025 онд сар бүр батлагдсан төгрөгийн зээлийн нийт дүн болон оны эхнээс хуримтлагдсан дүнг гарга
question_latin: 2025 ond sar bur batlagdsan togrogiin zeeliin niit dun bolon onii ekhnees khurimtlagdsan dung garga
question_en: For 2025, show the total MNT amount approved each month and the cumulative year-to-date approved amount.
question_mixed: 2025 онд сар бүр approve хийсэн төгрөгийн зээлийн дүн болон running total-ыг гарга
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM decided_date)::int AS month, SUM(approved_amount) AS approved_amount, SUM(SUM(approved_amount)) OVER (ORDER BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM decided_date)::int) AS cumulative_amount FROM t2s.loan_applications WHERE currency_code = 'MNT' AND status_code IN ('APPROVED','CONTRACTED','EXPIRED') AND decided_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question_mn: Энэ онд ирсэн хүсэлтүүдийн хэд нь тухайн харилцагчийн анхны хүсэлт, хэд нь давтан хүсэлт байсан бэ?
question_latin: Ene ond irsen hvseltvvdiin hed ni tuhain hariltsagchiin anhnii hvselt, hed ni dawtan hvselt baisan be?
question_en: Of the applications received this year, how many were the customer's first-ever application and how many were repeat applications?
gold_sql: WITH x AS (SELECT submitted_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY submitted_date, application_no) AS rn FROM t2s.loan_applications) SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE rn = 1) AS first_time, count(*) FILTER (WHERE rn > 1) AS repeat_applications FROM x WHERE submitted_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30'

question_mn: Нэгээс олон хүсэлт гаргасан харилцагчдын хувьд дараалсан хоёр хүсэлтийн хооронд дунджаар хэдэн хоног байдаг вэ?
question_latin: Negees olon hvselt gargasan hariltsagchdiin huwid daraalsan hoyor hvseltiin hoorond dundjaar heden honog baidag we?
question_en: For customers with more than one application, what is the average number of days between consecutive applications?
gold_sql: WITH x AS (SELECT submitted_date - LAG(submitted_date) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY submitted_date, application_no) AS gap_days FROM t2s.loan_applications) SELECT ROUND(AVG(gap_days), 2) AS avg_gap_days FROM x WHERE gap_days IS NOT NULL

question_mn: 2025 онд салбар бүрт ирсэн хүсэлтийн тоо болон нийт хүсэлтэд эзлэх хувийг гарга
question_latin: 2025 ond salbar bvrt irsen hvseltiin too bolon niit hvseltend ezleh huwiig garga
question_en: For 2025, show the number of applications submitted at each branch and its share of all applications.
gold_sql: SELECT b.branch_name, count(*) AS applications, ROUND(100.0 * count(*) / SUM(count(*)) OVER (), 2) AS share_pct FROM t2s.loan_applications a JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = a.branch_id WHERE a.submitted_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY b.branch_name
notes: Хаагдсан Баянгол-2 тооцооны төв 2026 онд 0 хүсэлттэй (-100%).
